newsitem.title: UK: BOE gives UK money market 1.21 bln stg more help.
newsitem.headline: BOE gives UK money market 1.21 bln stg more help.

text.p: The Bank of England said it provided the UK money market with a further 1.21 billion stg of assistance at established interest rates.
The operations comprised 1.0 billion stg in bills outright maturing on or before April 7 and 210 million stg in repos to April 7.
The Bank's repo rate is six percent.
It forecast a money market shortage of 1.5 billion stg and has now provided 1.347 billion in total assistance on Monday.
